an10.8:1.1: [sāvatthiyaṃ] saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti no ca sīlavā.
an10.8:1.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca, evaṃ so tenaṅgena paripūro hoti.
an10.8:2.1: saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti, sīlavā ca, no ca bahussuto …pe…
an10.8:2.4: parisāvacaro ca no ca visārado parisāya dhammaṃ deseti -
an10.8:2.5: visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti no ca vinayadharo -
an10.8:2.6: vinayadharo ca no ca āraññako pantasenāsano -
an10.8:2.7: āraññako ca pantasenāsano no ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī -
an10.8:2.8: catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī - no ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an10.8:2.11: ‘kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, vinayadharo ca āraññako ca pantasenāsano ca catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, āsavānañca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya’nti.
an10.8:3.1: yatho ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, vinayadharo ca āraññako ca pantasenāsano, catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, āsavānañca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an10.8:3.3: imehi kho bhikkhave dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabbākāra paripūrocāti.
